items.source: For example, the particular constructor to execute on a class may be discovered by a ConstructorResolver which then builds a ConstructorExecutor that executes that constructor, and the resolved ConstructorExecutor can be reused without needing to go back to the resolvers to discover the constructor again.
items.translation: 例如，特定类上需要执行的构造函数可由 `<code>ConstructorResolver`` 发现，进而构建一个执行该构造函数的 `<code>ConstructorExecutor``；且解析后的 `<code>ConstructorExecutor`` 可被重用，无需再次返回到解析器以重新发现构造函数。

items.source: If a ConstructorExecutor becomes stale, it should throw an AccessException which signals to the infrastructure to go back to the resolvers to ask for a new one.
items.translation: 如果 `ConstructorExecutor` 变得陈旧，它应该抛出一个AccessException，以通知基础设施返回到解析器处请求一个新的实例。

items.source: Execute a constructor in the specified context using the specified arguments.
items.translation: 使用指定的参数在指定的上下文中执行构造函数。

items.source: AccessException - if there is a problem executing the constructor or if this ConstructorExecutor has become stale
items.translation: AccessException - 如果构造函数执行出现问题，或者此 ConstructorExecutor 已过期。

items.source: context - the evaluation context in which the constructor is being executed
items.translation: context - 构造函数正在执行的评估上下文

items.source: arguments - the arguments to the constructor; should match (in terms of number and type) whatever the constructor will need to run
items.translation: arguments - 构造函数的参数；其数量和数据类型应与构造函数运行所需的内容相匹配。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
安迪·克莱门特，萨姆·布拉南
